meaning:
διά-γνωσις, -εως, ἡ
(διαγιγνώσκω), [in LXX: Wis.3:18 * ;]
1. a distinguishing, also as medical term.
2. As law-term (Lat. cognitio), determination, decision: Act.25:21 (Cremer, 674).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But when Paul had appealed to be kept for the decision of the emperor, I commanded him to be kept until I could send him to Caesar.”
